title: 3-16 合格人數與總分
subtitle: 條件計數與累加・廣東話・十個步驟

ui.paused: 已暫停・撳「繼續」去下一步
ui.finishedSub: 每筆都要讀，合格先計數同累加

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 3-16 輸入 N 個分數，只計 50 分或以上嘅合格分數。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 例如 N 係 5，分數係 49、50、75、0、100。要輸出合格人數，同合格分數嘅總和。

steps.title: 語法：變數同 cin 讀入

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 我哋由零開始睇語法。int N; 意思係開一個整數變數，叫 N，好似一個空盒。每句程式最後都要加分號。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: cin 就係由鍵盤讀入，箭咀符號指向 N，讀入嘅數就放入 N。輸入 5，N 就係 5。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 同上一題一樣，先設 count 同 sum 做零。k 負責控制讀幾多次，由 1 去到 N；score 就係而家讀入嘅分數。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 中間呢道閘就係條件：score 大過或等於 50。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 跟住學 for 迴圈，用嚟重複做嘢。括號入面有三個部分，用分號分開。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第一部分 int k = 1，係起點，只做一次。第二部分 k 細過或等於 N，係條件，成立就做大括號入面嘅嘢。第三部分 k 加加，每做完一輪 k 就加 1。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 大括號入面，每輪都會讀一個新分數。N 係 5，k 就由 1 去到 5，總共做 5 次。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: if 即係如果。括號入面放條件，條件成立，先會做大括號入面嘅嘢。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 大過等於號，即係大過或者等於。所以 50 大過或等於 50 成立，49 就唔成立。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: count 加加即係 count 加 1；sum 加等於 score，即係將分數加落 sum 度。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: k 等於 1，讀入第一個分數 49。49 細過 50，唔合格，count 同 sum 保持零。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 記住，唔合格都一定要讀，咁先會輪到下一筆。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: k 等於 2，讀入 50。50 大過或等於 50，合格！count 變做 1，sum 加 50。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 留意，用大過或等於，唔係大過，所以 50 分都計合格。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 跟住 75 合格，count 係 2，sum 係 125。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 0 唔合格，數值唔變。100 合格，count 係 3，sum 係 225。

steps.title: k 大過 N：迴圈結束、輸出

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: k 加到 6，大過 N，迴圈結束。輸出兩行：第一行合格人數 3，第二行總和 225。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 如果冇人合格，兩行都輸出 0。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 最後三個重點。第一，讀分數要放喺迴圈入面。第二，條件係 score 大過或等於 50。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第三，count 加加同 sum 加 score，兩句都要放喺 if 入面。

en.title: 3-16 Passing Count and Score Sum
en.subtitle: Conditional counting & summation · 10 steps
en.finishedSub: Read every score; count and add only the passing ones

ui.finishedSub: Read every score; count and add only the passing ones

steps.title: Problem: passing count and score sum

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Lesson 3-16. We read N scores, and only scores of 50 or more pass.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: For example, N is 5, and the scores are 49, 50, 75, 0, and 100. Print how many passed, and the total of the passing scores.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Let's start from zero. int N; creates an integer variable named N, like an empty box. Every statement ends with a semicolon.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: cin reads from the keyboard. The arrows point to N, so the number goes into N. If we type 5, N becomes 5.

steps.title: count, sum and the condition gate

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Like before, count and sum start at zero. k controls how many times we read, from 1 to N. score is the value we just read.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: This gate is the condition: score is greater than or equal to 50.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Next, the for loop. It repeats work. Inside the brackets are three parts, separated by semicolons.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Part one, int k equals 1, is the start. Part two, k less than or equal to N, is the condition. Part three, k plus plus, adds 1 to k after each round.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Inside the braces, each round reads one new score. N is 5, so k goes from 1 to 5. That is 5 rounds.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: if means: only when. The condition goes inside the brackets. When it is true, the code in the braces runs.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: The greater-than-or-equal sign means greater than, or equal to. So 50 is greater than or equal to 50, which is true. 49 is not.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: count plus plus adds 1 to count. sum plus equals score adds the score to sum.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: k is 1. We read the first score, 49. It is less than 50, so it fails. count and sum stay at zero.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Remember: read every score, even a failing one, so the next score comes up.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: k is 2. We read 50. 50 is greater than or equal to 50, so it passes! count becomes 1, and sum adds 50.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Use greater than or equal to, not just greater than, so fifty counts.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Next, 75 passes: count is 2, sum is 125.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: 0 fails, so nothing changes. 100 passes: count is 3, sum is 225.

steps.title: k > N: loop ends, print output

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: k reaches 6, which is greater than N, so the loop ends. We print two lines: 3 passed, and the total is 225.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: If nobody passes, both lines are 0.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Three key points. First, read each score inside the loop. Second, the condition is score greater than or equal to 50.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Third, count plus plus and sum plus equals score both go inside the if block.
